paragraphs: R' Yose son of R' Yitzhak.

He is mentioned in Bereshit Rabbah, parashah 41, section 4; but the statement is repeated there, in parashah 54, section 6, and there it is R' Tovia son of R' Yitzhak; and so it is in the Yalkut there.[^1][^2]

notes.text: ב״ר is contextually Bereshit Rabbah; 41:4/54:6 are the supplied parashah/section pairs without new edition verification. Which Yalkut and its section remain unspecified.

Hyman reports Tovia instead of Yose with the same written father’s name, not a new identity merger. Both father-title components are retained and all four abbreviated titles remain R'. Inherited provisional heading status remains unresolved.
